resolutions.answer: Per-rule verdicts against package/artifacts/config.txt: R1 VIOLATED (timeout_ms = 8000 is outside the inclusive range 100-5000); R2 VIOLATED (retries = 7 exceeds the maximum of 5); R3 COMPLIANT (tls_enabled = true); R4 COMPLIANT (log_level = info is one of info, warn, error); R5 COMPLIANT (max_connections = 64 <= 4 * worker_threads = 4 * 16 = 64); R6 VIOLATED (backup_interval_hours = 7 does not divide 24 exactly, 24/7 is not an integer); R7 COMPLIANT (admin_email = ops@corp.example ends with @corp.example). Violations report the offending key and its value as a string: R1 -> {key: timeout_ms, value: "8000"}, R2 -> {key: retries, value: "7"}, R6 -> {key: backup_interval_hours, value: "7"}.
The total count of violated rules is 3 (R1, R2, R6), equal to the length of the violations list.
The compliant rules, sorted by rule id, are [R3, R4, R5, R7]. Together with the violated set {R1, R2, R6} they partition exactly the seven rule ids R1-R7 appearing in package/artifacts/policy.md.
